Players Committee card image of [[General Nevar]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots (3 if Blizzard 2). Deploys -1 to Hoth. When deployed, may peek at top card of any Reserve Deck. When a spy here is targeted by Trample, adds 1 to your destiny draw.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/generalnevar.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
